summary: This clinical trial studies how well different diabetes drugs control blood sugar over time in adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus, a condition where the body cannot properly process sugar. Participants are assigned to receive one of three study medications: Imeglimin, Metformin, or Vildagliptin. The trial is currently Active, not recruiting and has an enrollment of 567 participants.

facts.sponsor: National Center for Global Health and Medicine, Japan
